description: A screenshot of a user interface form titled "Add Extraction." The form presents three input fields: "Name*", which is an empty text field marked as required for user input; "Country*", pre-filled with "ES Spain/España" and marked as required, with a clear button to remove the selection; and "Region", pre-filled with "ES616 Jaén", also with a clear button. A radio button labeled "10 meters" is selected, likely indicating a spatial resolution setting. At the bottom right of the form, there are two action buttons: "CANCEL" (green text) and "ADD" (solid green background).
